in_sanskrit.name: उदय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who uplifts or the one who represents the sunrise.

in_hindi.name: उदय
in_hindi.meaning: उद्यान (udyāna) - garden, or उद्यम (udyam) - courage, effort
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Udai' has multiple meanings in Hindi. It can be derived from 'उद्यान' (udyāna), which means 'garden'. Alternatively, it can be derived from 'उद्यम' (udyam), which means 'courage' or 'effort'. Both meanings carry a sense of growth and progress.

in_tamil.name: ஊதய
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name 'ஊதய' (Uthay) has the same meaning as 'Udai' in Sanskrit - Sunrise or Upliftment.

in_telugu.name: ఉదయ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name 'ఉదయ' (Udaya) has the same meaning as 'Udai' in Sanskrit - Sunrise or Upliftment.

in_marathi.name: Udai
in_marathi.long_meaning: Udai हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Udai is derived from the Sanskrit word 'uday' which means 'to rise', 'to uplift' or 'joy'. This name is associated with the Sun God and represents the joy and happiness that comes with new beginnings.

vedic_reference.note: The name 'Udai' has its roots in the Vedic tradition. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'उदय' (udaya), which means 'sunrise'. In Hindu mythology, the sun is often personified as the god Surya, and the sunrise is a symbol of new beginnings and the start of a new day.
